caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a hinged lid that is open, revealing the interior. The box is brown, indicating a wood texture, and has brass-colored hinges and a yellow diamond-shaped keyhole plate on the front. Inside, the box is divided into two main compartments: the left compartment is empty, and the right compartment contains a round, metallic bowl with a reflective surface. On the left side of the box, there is a round handle, also brown, matching the wood texture. The box rests on small, round feet, also brown. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small, outlined sketch of the same box, viewed from above, illustrating the object's shape and proportions. The main box is positioned slightly at an angle, showing both the front and left sides. The background is plain and off-white, with a faint rectangular border around the main drawing. The artist's signature and date are present in the lower right corner.
title: Sugar and Tea Box
